descriptions.text: Veriluxx RealPet Dungeon Crawl Special Edition Exclusive. “Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk.” Dungeon Crawler World: Earth. The ultimate play toy, Veriluxx RealPet Companions are budget-friendly, nearly indestructible collectibles that will give your child hours and hours of fun. Because these interactive toys do not require an implant certificate to play with and enjoy, parents needn’t worry about how many hours their children are spending with their new best friends! Mix and match! They fight! They love! They will share your deepest, darkest secrets! Each Veriluxx RealPet Companion is a fully licensed depiction of your favorite personality or creature. …

beats.headline: A product sample
beats.text: Donut hops up and down on Mongo: she has a new sponsor, Veriluxx RealPet Companions, and wonders who that is. Loita explains that Donut will soon receive a benefactor box from them that is really a product sample, part of the sponsorship contract. She is to take it out and interact with it a few times. Carl may make some of his famous comments, but should not disparage it too much if Donut wants a real box. In six or seven days, the two of them and Mongo go on a program to discuss the product.

beats.headline: It is Donut
beats.text: The box opens, and it is Donut: a toy robot Donut, about three-quarters her size, fur like rat hair, licking its paw in a stilted, mechanical way. I sure do like lasagna, it says. I hate Mondays, Carl. A 1980s commercial voice reads its description. It asks for Ferdinand, sends Ruby running, and tells Carl the void is wet and hungry. Donut is overjoyed: she has merch. Then the toy asks Mongo if he is a cocker spaniel and hisses, and Mongo decapitates it. It catches fire, and the cleaner bot foams it.

beats.headline: Three more, all broken
beats.text: The toy company has sent three more robot Donuts, and Mongo has promptly destroyed two. The third, supposedly more durable, has survived one attack. It jumps onto Carl's shoulder, wondering how long the babies will continue to cry in the dark, until he pushes it off and Mongo shakes it by the neck. The head rips, a countdown appears, and it explodes in sparks and smoke, scorching the front of the Spit and Swallow. Its marble-sized controller core has popped like popcorn. Loita says the sponsor now has to make the doll self-destruct if it is sufficiently broken, to keep Carl out of its parts.

beats.headline: Three times the weight
beats.text: The newest version weighs about three times as much as the last and is slightly bigger. Mongo attacks it at once and does no obvious damage. It still throws out bootleg Garfield quotes. A small panel on the back of its head is held shut by a cheap little tab, like a battery compartment; when Carl clicks it open, a warning gives five seconds until self-destruct, and he shoves it back. Patted on the head, it moans. Mordecai says the logo on the box suggests Veriluxx is associated with Veritan Linkage, a lending fund that advocates enslaving those who can't pay their taxes.

beats.headline: Left beside Loita
beats.text: Carl sets robot Donut on the green-room couch next to Loita and tells it to stay by her. It asks her if she has ever felt true cold. On the set of the Veriluxx New Toys Showcase, holo dolls of Donut and Mongo bounce on the table, and Carl goes off script: he likes how compliant the toy is, and isn't compliance the thing of their parent company, Veritan Linkage? Then the lights flicker and the studio goes red. In the green room the couch is obliterated, and Loita lies blackened, missing her left arm and both bottom legs, still alive.

beats.headline: The panel falls off
beats.text: Orren lays it out. Loita jumped down off the couch, the toy jumped after her, the panel on the back of its head dislodged, and a few seconds after that it exploded, killing her. Sitting on Carl's sapper's bench had raised its yield. Carl calls the panel a cheap piece of crap. What he does not say is that he shimmed the tab with a cut-down thumbnail as he set the toy beside her, knowing the heavy robot would jump the moment she stood up.
